name: ubuntu-24.04-desktop
status: declarative: no image is built from this profile yet; images/build.sh does not read profiles/
description: A VNC desktop for G15: Xvfb + Openbox + x11vnc on guest loopback, with Chromium. The gateway reaches the VNC server through the guest agent's loopback tunnel (davit desktop open); nothing listens on a guest NIC.

packages.note: Exact versions are resolved from the pinned Ubuntu snapshot and recorded in the built manifest's rootfs.packages, as for every image.

chromium.source: Chromium for Testing linux64 tarball (https://googlechromelabs.github.io/chrome-for-testing/), pinned by version and sha256 in images/inputs.lock when the profile is built
chromium.why: Ubuntu 24.04's chromium-browser deb is a transitional package for the snap, which cannot run in a sealed Firecracker rootfs.

desktop.vnc.security: none on 127.0.0.1 only (the gateway authenticates viewers by tailnet identity and enforces view-only)
